Method of Attack: Bypassing security checks protecting files and operational code in the module
Exploiting vulnerability to read Java code and embedded secrets from secure flash memory area
Controlling the module via AT commands over UART interface to access filesystem and issue configuration commands
Discoverer: X-Force Red, IBM’s independent team of veteran hackers
Impacted Systems: Cinterion EHS8 M2M module and related product line modules
Devices in automotive, energy, telecom, and medical sectors using these modules
Attack Vector: Physical UART connection to module’s AT command interface
